notes_for_editor: Thin record. The lookout history page has only the name, parish and the 2S-6E-Sec.36 line. The IEM station named Fluker Fire Tower lies about 1 km from the brief coordinates (30.8255, -90.559), but the sources do not say it sits on the lookout site. Two searches and about six reads; no build, staffing, fate or register record found. Story sits at the low end of the length range. Brief status unknown kept.
